tests.title: The conformance package keeps all code in _test.go files and adds no listener to the root module
given: the repository tree with internal/providerconformance/ present
tests.when: the package directory is parsed with go/parser, and every non-test .go file of the root module is scanned for net.Listen*, tls.Listen and http.ListenAndServe* selectors and for imports of internal/providerconformance
then: the only non-test file in internal/providerconformance is doc.go
doc.go declares nothing but the package doc comment and the package clause
no non-test file of the root module calls a listening API
no package imports internal/providerconformance
tests.pseudocode: files = glob('internal/providerconformance/*.go'); nonTest = [f for f in files if !f.endsWith('_test.go')]; assert nonTest == ['doc.go']; ast = parse(doc.go); assert len(ast.Decls)==0 and ast.Doc != nil; assert no importer of the package

tests.title: The suite runs 21 named subtests under -short and a -run pattern selects exactly one
given: go toolchain available to a test subprocess
the three vendor fakes compiled into the test binary
tests.when: go test -short -v ./internal/providerconformance runs TestProviderConformance, then again with -run 'TestProviderConformance.*/ollama/thinking'
then: the first run reports 21 passing subtests whose paths end in /<provider>/<case> for providers anthropic, openrouter, ollama and the seven case names
no subtest is skipped under -short
the second run reports exactly one passing subtest, ollama/thinking
tests.pseudocode: out = exec('go test -short -v -json ...'); passes = subtests with action pass; assert len(passes)==21; assert no skip; out2 = exec(... -run pattern); assert [s for s in subtests(out2)] == ['TestProviderConformance/ollama/thinking']

tests.title: Each subtest builds its agent through agentkit.New with only its provider's variables pointed at its own fake
given: a fake per subtest
a recording Getenv wrapper around the map-backed function
tests.when: each of the 21 subtests builds its agent and runs a case
then: agentkit.New received Provider equal to the provider name, Model "STANDARD", MaxTurns 4 and one tool named echo
the Getenv map holds only ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, or OPENROUTER_API_KEY and OPENROUTER_BASE_URL (ending /api/v1), or OLLAMA_HOST
every variable requested by the provider resolves to that subtest's own fake address
the fake records at least one request
tests.pseudocode: env = fakeEnv(provider, fake.URL); assert keys(env) subset of providerVars[provider]; agent = agentkit.New(Config{Provider:p, Model:'STANDARD', Getenv: lookup(env), Toolset: [echo], MaxTurns:4}); run; assert len(fake.requests) >= 1

tests.title: Outcomes are unchanged when conflicting provider variables are exported in the process environment
given: a decoy loopback listener that counts connections
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_BASE_URL and OLLAMA_HOST exported to values pointing at the decoy
tests.when: go test -short ./internal/providerconformance runs as a subprocess with that environment
then: all 21 subtests pass
the decoy listener accepted zero connections
no subtest connects anywhere other than its own fake
tests.pseudocode: decoy = listen('127.0.0.1:0'); env = os.Environ + decoy-pointing vars; r = exec(go test -short -json, env); assert pass==21; assert decoy.accepted == 0

tests.title: No suite file contains a literal catalog model id
given: the catalog's model ids collected from catalog.Select for every provider and tier
tests.when: every .go file in internal/providerconformance is scanned for string literals equal to or containing any of those ids
then: no literal model id appears in the suite
expected model ids in assertions are read from catalog.Select(provider, "STANDARD", "")
tests.pseudocode: ids = [catalog.Select(p,t,'').Model.ID for p in providers for t in tiers]; for lit in stringLiterals(files): assert not any(id in lit for id in ids)

tests.title: A subtest whose fake never answers is cancelled and fails naming provider and case
given: a fake that blocks without replying
the case runner invoked with a 200 ms context deadline and a recording testing.TB stand-in
a second independent subtest using a healthy fake
tests.when: the case runner executes the text case against the hanging fake
then: the runner returns within a bounded time instead of hanging
the stand-in recorded a failure whose message names the provider and the case
the healthy subtest still passes
tests.pseudocode: tb = recorder(); start = now(); runCase(tb, 'ollama', textCase, timeout=200ms); assert now()-start < 5s; assert tb.failed and 'ollama' in tb.msg and 'text' in tb.msg

tests.title: Each fake records the request and answers with the next scripted turn in order, echoing the model
given: each of the three fakes scripted with two logical turns of different text
tests.when: two POST requests with distinct bodies and headers are sent to the vendor endpoint of each fake (Anthropic /v1/messages, OpenRouter /api/v1/chat/completions, Ollama /api/chat)
then: the fake recorded method, path, headers and body of both requests in order
response 1 carries the first turn's text and response 2 the second turn's
each response echoes the model id sent in the request
tests.pseudocode: for f in fakes: r1 = post(f, body1); r2 = post(f, body2); assert f.requests[0].body == body1; assert text(r1)=='A' and text(r2)=='B'; assert model(r1)==requestedModel

tests.title: A request to another path or beyond the script fails the subtest and gets an HTTP error
given: each fake scripted with one turn
a recording testing.TB stand-in
tests.when: a POST arrives at /v1/other, then a valid request is made twice
then: the unknown-path request receives an HTTP error status and the stand-in recorded a failure naming /v1/other
the second valid request receives an HTTP error status and the failure names request number 2 beyond a script of 1
tests.pseudocode: post(f,'/v1/other'); assert status>=400 and '/v1/other' in tb.msgs[0]; post(f,valid); post(f,valid); assert status>=400 and 'request 2' in tb.msgs[1]

tests.title: The fakes render deltas, argument fragments and usage netting in each vendor's form
given: a logical turn with text, thinking and a tool call and usage of 100 prompt tokens, 60 cache reads, 20 output tokens and cost 0.00042
tests.when: each fake renders the turn and the raw response body is parsed with encoding/json
then: text and thinking each arrive as two deltas
tool arguments arrive as two fragments on Anthropic and OpenRouter and as one whole object on Ollama
Anthropic reports input_tokens 40 and cache_read_input_tokens 60
OpenRouter reports prompt_tokens 100 with cached_tokens 60 and cost 0.00042
Ollama reports prompt_eval_count 100 and prompt_eval_cached_count 60 and no cost field
tests.pseudocode: body = fake.render(turn); assert count(textDeltas)==2; assert fragments(tool)==(2 if p!='ollama' else 1); assert usageFields(p, body) == expected[p]

tests.title: The fakes render every turn ending exactly as the vendor sends it
given: each fake and each ending: normal stop, tool-call stop, cut off, HTTP error status, in-stream error
tests.when: each ending is rendered and the raw HTTP response is inspected
then: normal stop is Anthropic end_turn, OpenRouter finish_reason stop, Ollama done true with done_reason stop
tool-call stop is Anthropic tool_use, OpenRouter tool_calls, Ollama done_reason stop
cut off lacks message_stop on Anthropic, finish_reason on OpenRouter and done:true on Ollama
HTTP error status carries the vendor's error body with the message and the scripted status
in-stream error is an Anthropic event: error, an OpenRouter error chunk with code 502, or an Ollama {"error":…} line, after the blocks
tests.pseudocode: for p in providers: for end in endings: raw = fakes[p].render(turnWith(end)); assert matchesVendorForm(p, end, raw)

tests.title: Each fake decodes a recorded request into the same vendor-neutral summary
given: for each vendor a hand-written request body carrying model, effort, one tool echo, a user text, an assistant message with text, a tool call and replayed thinking, and a tool result
tests.when: each fake's decode function turns its body into a request summary
then: model, effort, declared tool names, user texts and tool results (call id, text) are equal across the three summaries
assistant text, tool call id, name and arguments are equal across the three summaries
replayed thinking text is equal and the raw vendor form holds Anthropic thinking plus signature, OpenRouter reasoning_details, Ollama thinking
effort is read from output_config.effort, reasoning.effort and think respectively
tests.pseudocode: s = [decode(p, body[p]) for p in providers]; assert s[0].Model==s[1].Model==s[2].Model; assert s[i].Assistant[0].ToolCalls equal; assert s[0].Assistant[0].RawThinking.signature=='sig-conformance'

tests.title: The fake source files import only the standard library and no vendor SDK or provider test helper

tests.title: Every recorded request in every case carries the selected model id and effort in the vendor's form

tests.when: each fake's recorded requests are decoded into request summaries

tests.title: A normally ending turn has the faux event skeleton and whole block-end payloads on every provider
given: the text, tool_call and thinking cases on each provider
a provider/faux reference provider scripted with the same blocks and stop reason

tests.title: A failed turn ends with a terminal ErrorEvent then a MessageEndEvent with StopReasonError

tests.title: The text case ends the run normally with the scripted text after one request
given: each provider's fake scripted with the text turn "Hello from the conformance suite." ending with the vendor's normal stop
tests.when: the agent runs with a user prompt
then: the assistant message has StopReasonStop
the run ends RunStopEndTurn with a nil error
FinalText equals "Hello from the conformance suite."
exactly one request was recorded and it carries the user prompt
tests.pseudocode: res = run(prompt); assert msg.StopReason==Stop; assert res.StopReason==RunStopEndTurn and res.Error==nil; assert res.FinalText()==text; assert len(reqs)==1 and prompt in decode(reqs[0]).UserTexts

tests.title: Usage is netted to the canonical form and priced correctly on every provider
given: the text case with 100 prompt tokens of which 60 are cache reads, 20 output tokens and, on OpenRouter only, cost 0.00042
the selected STANDARD row for each provider
tests.when: the turn's TurnEndEvent usage and the run usage are inspected
then: InputTokens is 40, CacheReadTokens 60, OutputTokens 20, ReasoningTokens at most OutputTokens
the cost bit is set
CostUSD equals 0.00042 on OpenRouter and provider.ComputeCost(row, usage) on anthropic and ollama
the run's usage is not flagged Unpriced
tests.pseudocode: u = turnEnd.Usage; assert u.InputTokens==40 and u.CacheReadTokens==60 and u.OutputTokens==20 and u.ReasoningTokens<=u.OutputTokens; assert u.Has(UsageCostUSD); assert u.CostUSD == (0.00042 if p=='openrouter' else ComputeCost(&row, u)); assert !res.Usage.Unpriced

tests.title: The tool_call case executes echo once and replays the call and its result on the next request

turn 2: text "All done."

then: echo ran once with arguments {"v":"conformance"}

tests.title: Thinking stays out of text events and the transcript keeps a ThinkingBlock then the tool use

turn 2: text

no TextStart, TextDelta or TextEnd event contains any part of the thinking

tests.title: A cut-off stream yields the provider's ErrStreamTruncated and RunStopError after one request

then: echo's call counter is 0

tests.title: An HTTP 400 surfaces as the provider's StatusError and stops the run after one request

tests.title: An in-stream error after content stops the run, keeps the partial text and is not retried

then: the terminal ErrorEvent text contains conformance-upstream-failure

tests.pseudocode: assert 'conformance-upstream-failure' in terminal.Err.Error(); assert res.StopReason==RunStopError; assert 'Working on it' in text(lastAssistant); assert len(reqs)==1 and calls==0
